source: Independent read-only review of only the revision-4 C2/C3 remainder corrections. A1-A9 and resolved C1, C4, C5, and C6 were not re-reviewed.

evidence: docs/specs/agentic-personal-data-vault.md:305-329 now names all ten broker kinds and the shared/variant field names, and :331-349 names both handshake request/response pairs.

The C2 tables still omit scalar types, cardinality, and closed nested shapes for many required fields: ImportProvenance/ImportLossEntry/ImportResult members, envelope metadata, AutofillBrokerTarget members, per-kind fields, receipt fields, privacy-status fields, and the broker error object. ImportResult.provenance and sourceIdentifiers are not given an unambiguous serialized shape.

The handshake section does not define the ok=false response shape or how an error is carried for import-begin and import-commit; 'Handshake errors use elf.padloc-broker-error.v1' is not a closed response schema.

plan.md:52-55, G005/G006 proof, and graph-candidate.json:G005/G006/G008 require fixtures and parsing, but do not bind exact fixture member paths or exact transport operation-to-schema mappings. G005, G006, and G008 can still choose incompatible wire layouts.
findingResolutions.requiredChange: Make the C2 contract executable without worker choices: add field types, constants, cardinality, enum domains, and closed nested object shapes for every import/envelope/target/variant/error field; define explicit success and failure response unions for import-begin and import-commit; and name the canonical fixture JSON paths plus the native/CDP operation mapping consumed by G005, G006, and G008.

evidence: Revision 4 adds click_text, click_button_text, scroll_table, and drag to the spec remainder, plan decision/inventory, graph G007 deliverable/proof, and G007 negative-test list.

magic-browser/src/runtime/form.ts:2119-2130 defines DragResult.valueBefore, valueAfter, ariaValueBefore, and ariaValueAfter; :2298-2308 populates those fields. These are direct value-bearing action outputs, but the revision-4 forbidden-output lists only input/textarea snapshot values, FormField.value/FormActionResult.value, and table cell values.

magic-browser/src/worker/typed-tools.ts:3178-3210 returns a pageSnapshot from click_text/click_button_text, and :3252-3400 returns allRows/headings from scroll_table. The plan and test spec name negative tool calls but do not define per-tool output schemas or assert that these returned objects contain only metadata/redacted data under the shared gate.
findingResolutions.requiredChange: Extend C3's value-forbidden contract to DragResult.valueBefore/valueAfter/ariaValueBefore/ariaValueAfter and any equivalent click/table payload; require metadata-only or redacted result schemas for all four tools in clean, unknown, and potentially-private cases; and add assertions that no value-bearing keys survive the worker boundary, with unknown/potentially-private negatives at each call site.

rationale: Revision 4 closes the naming and ownership gaps: all four C3 tools are inventoried and all broker kinds plus handshake names are present. It does not yet close the contracts at the field/type/nested-response level required for interoperable C2 fixtures and parsers, and it leaves drag's explicit value-bearing result fields outside the C3 redaction contract. These remain blocking plan-contract gaps, so implementation dispatch is not ready.
nextGate: Return to plan correction for the C2 field/transport schemas and the C3 drag/click/table output contracts, then independently review the corrected revision.
